title: Vector P2: strokes/lines split fills + intersecting lines segment each other
description: Depends on Vector P1. DONE (agent-1320). Strokes/lines split fills + intersecting lines segment each other, curve-preserving, via the P0 kernel + P1 fold path. Same-color UNION (no divider) still emits 1 loop.
